No cloud account. Your own VPS required.

Know what you install.

The release is signed and non-debuggable. It includes arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a and x86_64. Minimum Android 8; target Android 16. Use a fresh Ubuntu 24.04 VPS for installation.

Current alpha2 artifacts were prepared and tested on 13 October 2026. The published release page is the authoritative download source.

CHECK THE FILE

Verify before opening.

Compare the APK’s SHA-256 with the checksum file from the release. A checksum checks file identity; trust the source you use to obtain it.

APK / SHA-25687b06a1e2fbd54d4bd6cdd9c99ea8abf65f72732c7cc8406b1768e80066e028d
Check on a computer+

Download the APK and checksum file into the same folder. On Linux:

sha256sum rookstride-0.1.0-alpha2.apk

On macOS:

shasum -a 256 rookstride-0.1.0-alpha2.apk

On Windows PowerShell:

Get-FileHash .\rookstride-0.1.0-alpha2.apk -Algorithm SHA256
Check the signing certificate+

With Android SDK Build Tools installed, inspect the APK:

apksigner verify --verbose --print-certs rookstride-0.1.0-alpha2.apk

Expected signing-certificate SHA-256:

751386cf7143ba92c88084a0b26dfeac86128b2fe0d5277821ee4c67a92ae7ba

Alpha2 uses the same signer as alpha1. Compare release information when updating; do not substitute an unsigned or debug build.

On Android, use a trusted local checksum tool if available, or verify on your computer before transferring the APK. Follow Android’s normal installation and VPN permission prompts.

EVIDENCE / 13 OCTOBER 2026

Tested repeatedly.
Still an alpha.

The same signed release APK was reset, installed and connected through three consecutive emulator/VPS cycles. Independent server checks accompanied each run.

Earlier 0.1.0-alpha2 single-server cycles
CycleAndroid emulatorResultAdditional check
01Android 16 / API 36PassedManaged package purge; injected stale control socket
02Android 9 / API 28PassedSigned alpha1 → alpha2 upgrade and Keystore checks
03Android 8 / API 26PassedUpgrade, VPS reboot and recovery before connecting

What those cycles verified

  • Gateway data reset, certificates regenerated, SSH preserved.
  • App-driven installation, account management and profile export.
  • Healthy services, private DNS/dashboard, blocked ad domain.
  • Real IKEv2/EAP tunnel through the embedded engine.
  • A separate app UID’s HTTPS exit IPv4 matched the VPS.
  • Literal IPv6 probe failed; emulator underlay was not a real IPv6 mobile network.

25 Python and 86 Android JVM tests also passed. APK/ELF 16-KiB alignment was checked for all 24 native libraries; actual 16-KiB runtime testing remains.

What remains to prove

  • Rookstride APK on physical Android 8 and 16 devices, with normal permission prompts and OEM restrictions.
  • Mobile/Wi-Fi handoff, real IPv6-capable networks and disconnected lockdown.
  • Sustained load, many clients and resource use on a 1-GB VPS.
  • Native 16-KiB runtime behavior and certificate-bound device authentication.

An official strongSwan profile was tested on the owner’s physical phone during alpha1. That does not replace physical testing of this APK.
